subset_rule: Highest total shipped units in modelling TRAIN weeks only; SKU alphabetical tie-break. Not representative of every SKU.
scenario_rule: Starting stock is ceil(TRAIN weekly mean times cover). No initial pipeline. Fixed assumptions, not tuned to inventory outcomes.
demand_proxy: Observed historical shipped units; same external series for both policies. Not true demand or observed lost sales.
timing: Beginning of week: receive due orders, review and place order. Then weekly proxy demand occurs. Lead 1 arrives next week before demand.
shortages: Lost within simulation, not backordered. Forecast inputs still use external historical series, not simulated fulfilled sales.
limitations: Only two held-out weeks. Scenario design added after forecast scores existed. Exploratory simulation, not a new untouched validation or real business benefit. No costs, capacity, MOQ, returns or supplier failures. End-of-week average stock is not daily average stock.
